Please Try Again. Powered by Reelgood Paradise‘s Season 2 finale is almost here, or as creator Dan Fogelman would say: It’s the final countdown. On the heels of a jaw-dropping, mind-blowing Episode 7, we’ve never been more excited to see what the hit Hulu series has in store. Will the major Alex mystery be revealed? Will Xavier (Sterling K. Brown) find Link (Thomas Doherty) and catch him up about Annie (Shailene Woodley) and his baby? Will Teri (Enuka Okuma) reunite with her kids? Is Jane (Nicole Brydon Bloom) really dead? What other plans does Sinatra (Julianne Nicholson) have up her sleeve? And, uh, what will become of the bunker after those terrifying conflicting commands? Season 2, Episode 7 also has to explain that huge Sinatra/Link/Dylan twist. So needless to say, we’re counting down the days until we learn what Episode 8 has in store/ Hulu’s official synopsis for Paradise Season 2, Episode 8, “Exodus” is as follows: “Worlds collide. Time is of the essence for Xavier. Link and his team spring into action. Sinatra puts it all on the line.” Decider also got Season 2 finale teases from Nicholson, Doherty, Shahi, and Ryan Michelle Bathé, who promised an “explosive” episode. When does Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 premiere on Hulu? What time do new episodes of Paradise come out?How many episodes are in Paradise Season 2 all together? And will there be a Paradise Season 3? We’ve got answers! Here’s everything to know about Paradise Season 2, Episode 8, including premiere date, time, how many episodes, and more. When Does Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 Come Out? Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 Premiere Date: Curious when Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 comes out? You can stream Episode 8 starting Monday, March 30. But depending on which timezone you’re in you may be able to watch sooner… What Time Does Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 Come Out? New episodes of Paradise Season 2 premiere on Hulu Mondays at 12:00 a.m. ET, which means they’ll be available to stream on Sundays at 9:00 p.m. PT. So Paradise Season 2, Episode 8 will be streaming on Monday, March 30 at 12:00 a.m. ET / Sunday, March 29 at 9:00 p.m. PT. When Is The Paradise Season 2 Finale? After the three-episode Season 2 premiere on Monday, February 23, new episodes of Paradise will drop weekly on Mondays — or Sundays if you’re on the west coast! That means new episodes will be available to stream every week until the Season 2 finale airs on Monday, March 30. How Many Episodes Are In Paradise Season 2? Like Season 2 before it, Paradise Season 2 consists of eight episodes. Paradise Season 2 Episode Guide: When Do New Episodes Of Paradise Come Out? Looking for a Paradise Season 2 episode guide with corresponding premiere dates? We’ve got you covered: Season 2, Episode 1: Monday, February 23 Season 2, Episode 2: Monday, February 23 Season 2, Episode 3: Monday, February 23 Season 2, Episode 4: Monday, March 2 Season 2, Episode 5: Monday, March 9 Season 2, Episode 6: Monday, March 16 Season 2, Episode 7: Monday, March 23 Season 2, Episode 8: Monday, March 30 Will There Be A Paradise Season 3? You bet! On March 17, ahead of Season 2’s final two episodes, Hulu renewed Paradise for Season 3. Since the start, creator Dan Fogelman was open about having a three-season arc in mind. He’s also said he plans to end the series after its third season. So we’ll have to wait and see if that’s still the course he plans to take. How To Watch Paradise: Hulu Streaming Info Since Paradise is a Hulu original series, you’ll have to be a subscriber to watch. (You can also watch through Hulu on Disney+ if you’re a bundle subscriber.) Season 1 aired on broadcast following its finale, so it’s likely that will be the case with Season 2. But until then, here’s how to watch: If you’re new to Hulu, you can get started with a 30-day free trial on the streamer’s basic (with ads) plan. After the trial period, you’ll pay $10.99/month. If you want to upgrade to Hulu ad-free, it costs $18.99/month. If you want to stream even more and save a few bucks a month while you’re at it, we recommend subscribing to one of the Disney+ Bundles, all of which include Hulu. These bundles start at $12.99/month for ad-supported Disney+ and Hulu and goes up to $32.99/month for Disney+, Hulu, and Max, all ad-free. Stay tuned for more Paradise Season 2 coverage from Decider.
